cases.evidenceSummary: S-Form commenced a cash tender offer on 2026-06-29 for up to 2,200,000 Dongil Steel shares, with the offer open through 2026-07-20.
cases.rationale: The tender offer was operative from the filing date; it is one document-level offer.

cases.evidenceSummary: The effective shelf prospectus covers fifteen separately numbered Kiwoom ELS offerings, series 4128 through 4142, with subscription and payment still future.
cases.rationale: Each numbered series is an independently operative pending offering, preserved in ascending document order.

cases.evidenceSummary: The prospectus offers 8,200,000 new common shares through an existing-shareholder rights offering followed by a general offering, with September subscription and payment dates.
cases.rationale: The filing establishes one pending rights offering; the two subscription channels are stages of the same issuance.

cases.evidenceSummary: SK reports that all 17,981 treasury shares approved for executive long-term incentives were transferred over three execution dates.
cases.rationale: The three transfers execute one disclosed treasury-share disposal program, which is complete and effective.

cases.evidenceSummary: SeAH Holdings reports completion and settlement of its tender offer, purchasing the maximum 187,000 shares after 499,122 shares were tendered.
cases.rationale: The results filing establishes one completed tender offer.

cases.evidenceSummary: The shelf supplement covers two separately numbered Kyobo K-ELS offerings, series 25 and 26.
cases.rationale: The two securities series are independent pending offerings and retain document order.

cases.evidenceSummary: SK hynix board-approved an increased estimated fourth-quarter purchase amount from affiliate SK Inc. for system development and maintenance services.
cases.rationale: The change concerns a future-quarter related-party goods/services transaction and remains proposed.

cases.evidenceSummary: The maximum-shareholder group aggregate increased by 40,000 shares following a relative’s market purchase.
cases.rationale: The maximum-shareholder-ownership-change template requires one aggregate document-level event.

cases.evidenceSummary: The issuer filed its semiannual report for the period ending March 2026.
cases.rationale: A semiannual report is one effective periodic-report occurrence; historical tables are not separately labeled.

cases.evidenceSummary: Samsung Securities reports two second-quarter customer-deposit transactions totaling KRW 20.3 billion with a relative of the group controller.
cases.rationale: The quarterly form’s document-level intent is the effective related-party deposit-product transaction disclosure.

cases.evidenceSummary: The filing reports an effective change in the aggregate maximum-shareholder group’s ownership position.
cases.rationale: The maximum-shareholder-ownership-change template applies to the document-level aggregate.

cases.evidenceSummary: Ascendio reports full subscription, allocation, and payment of KRW 999,999,966 for a third-party allotted small public offering.
cases.rationale: The small-offering results establish one completed securities issuance.

cases.evidenceSummary: HMM discloses a 2026-2030 fleet, network, terminal, and net-zero investment strategy totaling approximately KRW 29 trillion and expressly identifies it as forward-looking.
cases.rationale: The document-level event is a projected long-term business plan.

cases.evidenceSummary: Taeyoung E&C board-approved a future affiliate transaction transferring rights and obligations under two land sale contracts for an aggregate KRW 74.705 billion.
cases.rationale: The two land contracts are combined into one coextensive internal transaction whose scheduled execution remained pending.

cases.evidenceSummary: KR Motors set 2026-08-11 as the record date for shareholders entitled to oppose a small-scale merger.
cases.rationale: The record date was decided but remained future.

cases.evidenceSummary: The filer plans to purchase 279,330 common shares on-market between 2026-07-20 and 2026-08-18.
cases.rationale: The filing discloses one proposed insider/major-holder trading plan, not an executed ownership change.

cases.evidenceSummary: The maximum-shareholder group aggregate increased by 1,498 shares through two affiliate market purchases.
cases.rationale: The maximum-shareholder-ownership-change template requires one aggregate event despite multiple execution dates.

cases.evidenceSummary: Blue Industrial Development decided a third-party allotted paid-in capital increase of 5,012,531 shares, with payment scheduled for 2026-11-13.
cases.rationale: The board decision creates a proposed equity capital increase whose payment and issuance remain outstanding.

cases.evidenceSummary: The maximum-shareholder holding reported from the shareholder register increased by 266,503 shares to 8.90%.
cases.rationale: The maximum-shareholder-ownership-change template applies.

cases.evidenceSummary: The corrected material report preserves the board-approved Korean Air absorption merger of Asiana Airlines, with shareholder approval and the 2026-12-16 effective date still outstanding.
cases.rationale: The correction updates disclosures around the same proposed merger and does not convert the underlying lifecycle to corrected.

cases.evidenceSummary: The corrected business-group-status document was unavailable because the OpenDART ZIP entry exceeded the decompressed-byte limit.
cases.rationale: No document text was available for prediction-blind adjudication.

cases.evidenceSummary: The issuer filed its quarterly report for the period ending March 2026.
cases.rationale: A quarterly report is one effective periodic-report occurrence.

cases.evidenceSummary: The general large-holding filing reports an aggregate increase to 54.20% and, as a separate stated reporting reason, four major-contract changes: one share trust termination, one pledge release, one new pledge, and one increase in pledged shares.
cases.rationale: The aggregate holding change and the four independently operative contract changes are co-primary disclosure intents; their table order and distinct lifecycle effects are preserved.

cases.evidenceSummary: Woori Financial terminated its KRW 200 billion treasury-share trust on 2026-06-10 after acquiring 5,986,638 shares and transferring them to direct ownership.
cases.rationale: The filing’s primary intent is the effective termination of one treasury-share trust program.

cases.evidenceSummary: The corrected merger report document was unavailable because OpenDART returned provider status 014, file not found.
cases.rationale: No document text was available for prediction-blind adjudication.

cases.evidenceSummary: The issuer filed a substantive correction to its 2025 annual business report.
cases.rationale: The correction updates the same annual-report occurrence; the wrapper is not used as the underlying lifecycle state.

cases.evidenceSummary: Socar terminated its KRW 3 billion treasury-share cash trust on 2026-07-23 after acquiring 265,871 shares and transferring them to direct ownership.
cases.rationale: The filing’s primary intent is the effective termination of one treasury-share trust program.

cases.evidenceSummary: Major shareholder Magic Holdings plans an after-hours sale of 2,000,000 Korea Special Steel shares between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-25.
cases.rationale: The filing discloses one proposed major-holder trading plan, not an executed disposal.

cases.evidenceSummary: The issuance-results report gives separate final allocations for Yuanta ELS series 5807 through 5813, paid on 2026-07-24.
cases.rationale: The seven numbered securities series are independent completed issuances and retain document order.

cases.evidenceSummary: Hyundai E&C schedules an institutional-investor results NDR for 2026-08-03 through 2026-08-05.
cases.rationale: The IR event is formally scheduled but had not yet occurred.

cases.evidenceSummary: NH Investment & Securities files shelf supplemental terms for N2 Retirement Pension ELS series 77.
cases.rationale: One separately numbered security offering is filed with subscription and issuance outstanding.

cases.evidenceSummary: Hanwha Ocean invested USD 40 million in an affiliate securities firm’s RP product on 2026-07-22 for a term ending 2026-08-24.
cases.rationale: The affiliate financial investment was executed and remains active for its stated term.

cases.evidenceSummary: DH Autonex reports two new independent directors and one independent director’s voluntary resignation, all effective 2026-07-24.
cases.rationale: The two appointments and the separate resignation are three co-primary governance occurrences in disclosed order.

cases.evidenceSummary: The maximum-shareholder group aggregate increased by 82,461 shares through two purchases by a relative.
cases.rationale: The maximum-shareholder-ownership-change template requires one aggregate event.

cases.evidenceSummary: Galaxia SM corrects an incorrectly entered 15-to-30-day supplier-payment amount for the second half of 2025.
cases.rationale: The substantive supplier-payment disclosure is effectively updated; the correction wrapper is not its lifecycle.
